components.selected_profile: 80 explicitly prefixed functions: ASCII/Unicode classification, memory/string algorithms, sorting/search, integer conversion, arithmetic, pseudo-random, two absolute-value math functions
components.availability: compiled C99 static target; Linux x86_64 verification, other platforms not executed
notes: This is a selected algorithm library, not a complete libc or replacement host runtime. Every public ABI symbol begins lmx_ea_.

APSL sources strcpy/strcat/strncpy/strncat/strtol/strtoul/atof are excluded; realloc excluded for unsafe old-allocation read; atoi/atol/atoll and all CRT/stdio/time/locale replacement surfaces omitted.
No gdtoa/openlibm/printf submodule or build-time fetch. malloc/free are provided by host/application.
Public wide character input uses explicitly fixed 32-bit lmx_ea_wint_t and lmx_ea_wchar_t, independent of host wchar_t width.
strtoll/strtoull saturate on overflow without errno. Valid bases are 0 or 2..36. ASCII alphabetic digit conversion in strtoull is repaired in the guarded build view.
rand/srand and strtok have process-global state; rand_r and strtok_r allow actor-owned state. Unicode tables have the version supplied by the pinned upstream source, not a promise of latest Unicode.
calloc multiplication-overflow threshold uses size_t instead of unsigned long for LLP64 portability. GNU aliasing optimizations are disabled for isolated renamed builds.

Guarded build view corrects signed Unicode range comparisons and supplementary-plane case direction, uses the distinct wide-table index in wcwidth, and replaces host wcschr use with an explicit 32-bit whitespace scan. Wide API input must be a valid Unicode scalar; retained tables are not a complete Unicode conformance guarantee.
